links.comparator_used: Cloud-based baseline model on the primary MIMIC-IV benchmark
links.effect: On-premise agent achieved 90.04% accuracy (seven-disease task) and 83.8% (four-disease task), approaching the cloud baseline on the primary benchmark
links.quote: Across two Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV (MIMIC-IV)-derived benchmarks, the agent achieved 90.04% accuracy on a seven-disease task and 83.8% accuracy on a four-disease task, approaching a cloud baseline on the primary benchmark.

links.effect: Diagnostic behavioral consistency AUC = 0.860, and AUC = 0.875 under stress testing
links.quote: Diagnostic behavioral consistency provided the strongest discrimination of correctness (area under the curve (AUC) = 0.860) and remained informative under stress testing (AUC = 0.875).

links.comparator_used: Autonomous handling of all cases without a consistency cutoff (overall accuracy of the agent)
links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy in the retained (autonomously handled) subset
links.effect: At a consistency threshold of 0.90, 49.4% of cases retained at 98.9% diagnostic accuracy
links.tradeoff: Only about half of cases (49.4%) are handled autonomously; the remainder are deferred for human review
links.quote: At a consistency threshold of 0.90, 49.4% of cases were retained at 98.9% diagnostic accuracy.

design_hint: uncertainty-based selective autonomy with deferral to human review
